en.t: The following year, the Second Princess completed her period of mourning.

units.source_text: 因此议婚之事更是无所顾虑了。

en.t: Thus there was even less cause for hesitation in discussing the marriage.

units.source_text: 也有一些人向薰中纳言进言道：“看样子，只要你开口求婚，今上就会答应。”

en.t: Some people also advised Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, saying, "It seems that if you simply ask for her hand, His Majesty will agree."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言寻思：过分冷淡，只当作不知，也太荒唐无礼了。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, reflected that to remain too cold and pretend ignorance would be absurdly rude.

units.source_text: 于是每逢机会，也就隐约吐露求婚之意。

en.t: So whenever an opportunity arose, he faintly let his intention to propose be known.
There was no reason His Majesty would ignore this.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听人传说，今上已经定下结婚日期。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, heard from others that His Majesty had already fixed the wedding date.

units.source_text: 他自己也已察知今上的意思。

en.t: He himself had also already discerned His Majesty's intention.

units.source_text: 然而心中还在悲伤那短命而死的宇治大女公子，无时或忘。

en.t: Yet in his heart he still grieved for the Uji elder princess who had died so young, and he never forgot her for a moment.

units.source_text: 宿缘如此深厚的人，为何终于不得结为夫妇？”

en.t: Why was I never able to become husband and wife with someone to whom I was bound by such deep karma?"

units.source_text: 回想过去，但觉莫名其妙。

en.t: Looking back on the past, he could only feel that it made no sense.

units.source_text: 他常常想：“即使是品貌较差的人，只要略微有一点肖似宇治大女公子，我也会钟情于她。

en.t: He often thought, "Even if a woman were inferior in looks and character, if she resembled the Uji elder princess even slightly, I would fall in love with her.

units.source_text: 安得昔时汉武帝那种返魂香，让我再见她一面才好！”

en.t: If only I could obtain the soul-returning incense once used by Emperor Wu of Han, and see her one more time!"

units.source_text: 他并不盼望和那高贵的二公主结婚的日期早些来到。

en.t: He did not wish for the day of his marriage to that noble Second Princess to come any sooner.
